attackers_goals: Gain initial access to the cloud console.
description: Multiple failed logins were observed in a short period of time from a single external IP. The IP is not a known identity provider.
investigative_actions: Check if the IP is a known IP. Check if a successful login from the same IP occurred after the failed login attempts.
name: Multiple failed logins from a single IP
